entry.en: British-passport travellers need a passport that expires at least 6 months after arrival in Côte d’Ivoire.
entry.es: Los viajeros con pasaporte británico necesitan un pasaporte que caduque al menos 6 meses después de llegar a Côte d’Ivoire.
entry.quote: To enter Côte d’Ivoire, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: A visa is required, and the e-visa should be applied for and paid online at least 10 working days before travel.
entry.es: Se requiere visado, y el e-visa debe solicitarse y pagarse en línea al menos 10 días laborables antes del viaje.
entry.quote: Apply and pay for an e-visa online at least 10 working days before you travel to allow time for your application to be processed.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required to enter Côte d’Ivoire.
entry.es: Se requiere un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla para entrar en Côte d’Ivoire.
entry.quote: To enter Côte d’Ivoire, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination.

entry.en: You can bring up to 500,000 West African CFA francs in cash, and any foreign currency must be declared.
entry.es: Se pueden llevar hasta 500.000 francos CFA de África Occidental en efectivo, y hay que declarar cualquier moneda extranjera.
entry.quote: You can take up to 500,000 West African CFA francs in cash into Côte d’Ivoire. You must declare any foreign currency.

entry.en: Travellers arriving from Ebola-affected countries should expect to give health information and be screened, and may be monitored for up to 21 days.
entry.es: Quienes lleguen de países afectados por el ébola deben esperar dar información de salud y someterse a control, y pueden ser vigilados hasta 21 días.
entry.quote: You should expect to provide health information, undergo health screening, and may be monitored for up to 21 days after arrival.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 40km of the borders with Burkina Faso and Mali.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 40 km de las fronteras con Burkina Faso y Malí.
safety.quote:
FCDO advises against all travel to:

- within 40km of the borders with Burkina Faso and Mali

safety.en: FCDO advises against all but essential travel within 20km of the Liberia border because of the risk of serious violence by local militias.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja los viajes no esenciales a menos de 20 km de la frontera con Liberia por el riesgo de violencia grave de milicias locales.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all but essential travel to within 20km of the border with Liberia owing to the risk of serious violence by local militias.

safety.en: There is a risk of violent crime in Abidjan, including armed break-ins and armed hold-ups in the street.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de delitos violentos en Abiyán, incluidos robos armados en domicilios y atracos armados en la calle.
safety.quote: There is a risk of violent crime in Abidjan, including armed break-ins to private residences and armed hold-ups in the street.

safety.en: Ocean currents along the coast are very strong, rip tides cause many drownings each year, and there is no lifeboat or rescue service.
safety.es: Las corrientes del océano en la costa son muy fuertes, las corrientes de resaca causan muchos ahogamientos al año y no hay servicio de salvamento.
safety.quote: Ocean currents are very strong along the coast. Rip tides cause many swimming accidents and drownings each year. There is no lifeboat or rescue service.

safety.en: Unofficial roadblocks are a danger, as travellers could be robbed or assaulted.
safety.es: Los controles de carretera no oficiales son un peligro, ya que podrían robar o agredir a los viajeros.
safety.quote: Beware of unofficial roadblocks – you could be robbed or assaulted.

safety.en: Same-sex sexual activity is not illegal in Côte d’Ivoire, but same-sex partnerships and marriage are not legally recognised.
safety.es: La actividad sexual entre personas del mismo sexo no es ilegal en Côte d’Ivoire, pero la ley no reconoce las uniones ni el matrimonio entre personas del mismo sexo.
safety.quote: Same-sex sexual activity is not illegal in Côte d’Ivoire, but the law does not recognise same-sex partnerships or marriage.

health.en: Medical facilities in Abidjan are of a reasonable standard but can be expensive.
health.es: Los centros médicos de Abiyán tienen un nivel razonable pero pueden ser caros.
health.quote: Medical facilities in Abidjan are of a reasonable standard but can be expensive.

health.en: Medical facilities outside Abidjan are rudimentary.
health.es: Los centros médicos fuera de Abiyán son rudimentarios.
health.quote: Outside of Abidjan medical facilities are rudimentary.

health.en: Tap water is generally not drinkable, so stick to bottled water.
health.es: El agua del grifo generalmente no es potable, así que conviene beber agua embotellada.
health.quote: Tap water is generally not drinkable. Stick to bottled water.

health.en: Serious medical treatment could require medical evacuation back to the UK.
health.es: Un tratamiento médico grave podría requerir evacuación médica al Reino Unido.
health.quote: Serious medical treatment could require medical evacuation back to the UK.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 185, fire 180 and police 110, 111 or 170.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 185, bomberos 180 y policía 110, 111 o 170.

getting_in.en: Felix-Houphouet Boigny International Airport in Abidjan has daily scheduled flights to and from Paris and Brussels.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Felix-Houphouet Boigny de Abiyán tiene vuelos diarios programados a París y Bruselas.
getting_in.quote: The Felix-Houphouet Boigny International Airport has daily scheduled flights to and from Paris with Air France and Brussels with Brussels airlines.

getting_in.en: Sitarail operates weekly trains from Ouagadougou in Burkina Faso to Abidjan.
getting_in.es: Sitarail opera trenes semanales de Uagadugú, en Burkina Faso, a Abiyán.
getting_in.quote: There are weekly trains from Ouagadougou in Burkina Faso to Abidjan, operated by Sitarail.

getting_in.en: Buses run daily between Abidjan and Accra.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses diarios entre Abiyán y Accra.
getting_in.quote: Buses run daily between Abidjan and Accra.

getting_in.en: Entering Côte d'Ivoire from Guinea, Liberia, Mali or Burkina Faso is ill advised.
getting_in.es: No se aconseja entrar en Côte d'Ivoire desde Guinea, Liberia, Malí o Burkina Faso.
getting_in.quote: It  is ill advised to try to enter Côte d'Ivoire from Guinea, Liberia, Mali, or Burkina Faso.

getting_around.en: Taxis are an easy way to get around Abidjan; look for an orange car and flag it down.
getting_around.es: Los taxis son una forma fácil de moverse por Abiyán; hay que buscar un coche naranja y hacerle señas.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are a great and easy way to get around in Abidjan. Just look for an orange coloured car and flag it down.

getting_around.en: Bargain over the fare before getting into a taxi.
getting_around.es: Hay que negociar la tarifa antes de subir al taxi.
getting_around.quote: Always bargain before you get into the taxi.

getting_around.en: Very frequent military checkpoints can add hours to intercity trips.
getting_around.es: Los controles militares, muy frecuentes, pueden añadir horas a los viajes entre ciudades.
getting_around.quote: The downside is the very frequent military checkpoints which add hours to a trip.

getting_around.en: FCDO recommends using ride-hailing apps where possible, although no taxi can be guaranteed safe.
getting_around.es: El FCDO recomienda usar aplicaciones de transporte cuando sea posible, aunque ningún taxi es totalmente seguro.
getting_around.quote: Although no taxi can be guaranteed safe, we recommend using ride-hailing apps where possible.

money.en: The currency is the West African CFA franc (XOF).
money.es: La moneda es el franco CFA de África Occidental (XOF).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the West African CFA franc, denoted CFA (ISO currency code: XOF).

money.en: ATMs are generally available at banks in urban areas and accept both Visa and Mastercard.
money.es: Los cajeros automáticos suelen estar en bancos de zonas urbanas y aceptan Visa y Mastercard.
money.quote: ATMs are generally available at banks in urban areas and accept both Visa and Mastercard.

etiquette.en: The country has asked to be called "Côte d'Ivoire" rather than "Ivory Coast" in English.
etiquette.es: El país ha pedido que se le llame "Côte d'Ivoire" y no "Ivory Coast" en inglés.
etiquette.quote: the country has requested that it be called "Côte d'Ivoire"

etiquette.en: Dress modestly when visiting religious places or buildings.
etiquette.es: Hay que vestir con modestia al visitar lugares o edificios religiosos.
etiquette.quote: Dress modestly when visiting religious places or buildings.
